minutes.headline: Town Meeting passed amended Article 1 and TC Passios design study; 10-year building sale moratorium failed
minutes.summary: The meeting spent most time on Article 1 (FY18 budget adjustments, building repairs and a condition assessment), Article 4 (conceptual design for moving town offices to TC Passios) and Article 11 (citizen petition for a 10-year moratorium on selling five town buildings). Article 1 passed as amended, Article 4 passed on a majority voice vote, and Article 11 failed on a counted vote. Union contract transfers, revolving funds, a playground request, speed-limit and parking acceptances and stormwater bylaw moves were also taken up.

what_happened.line: Town Meeting passed Article 1, the FY18 budget adjustments, as amended, on a two-thirds vote after a long debate over building repairs and reserves.
An amendment to Article 1 by counted hands was defeated, and an earlier amendment to the amendment failed.
Article 4, a transfer for conceptual design of moving town offices to TC Passios, passed on a majority vote.
Article 11, a citizen petition for a 10-year moratorium on selling five municipal buildings, failed on a counted vote.
The firefighters and municipal employees contract transfers (Articles 2 and 3) passed unanimously.

why_it_matters: Article 1 draws on town funds, mostly taxes, for building repairs and a condition assessment, and Article 4 starts design work that could lead to a later vote on moving town offices.
With the moratorium defeated, the five town buildings can still be considered for sale, and any sale would come back as a separate decision.
watch_next: A Town Hall building walkthrough on December 2nd and a town center charette on December 7th.
The conceptual design and cost estimate for town offices at TC Passios, which would inform any later funding vote.
